paragraphs: In Pesikta de-Rav Kahana, ט:, R' Yudan reports in the name of R' Shmuel bar Funia, who reports in the name of Bar Kappara. The glosses of רש״ב give several variants.

notes.text: The locator is printed ט:. The glossator’s initials רש״ב remain unresolved. The entry heading supplies Shmuel for ר״ש.

Pesikta de-Rav Kahana is the contextual work expansion and ט: remains literal, without invented modern foliation. The heading supplies Shmuel for ר״ש, but not an expanded personal title: all three abbreviated personal-title occurrences remain R'. The passive variant-readings wording avoids deciding the subject of מביא. רש״ב is unresolved; the uninspected Shlomo Buber lead remains research history rather than an adopted identification.

Solomon Buber’s Lyck edition (1868, fol. 9b) has the chain Hyman quotes and gives alternative readings in note קסד. In the consulted Mandelbaum text (section 1), Shmuel bar Nachman appears in place of Shmuel bar Funia, and R. Chonaya appears before Bar Kappara. Buber reports further variants from the Yalkut, Midrash Tehillim, Chazit and Bamidbar Rabbah. Those witnesses are cited here through his note.
